name: Bronte Hughes
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a passion for engineering during her university years. She initially focused on vehicle dynamics, quickly becoming captivated by the intricate interplay of mechanics and strategy in racing. After graduating, Bronte gained experience at a smaller racing outfit before landing a role at Lechner Racing. 

As Sporting Director, Bronte is known for her meticulous planning and relentless pursuit of improvement. She believes that success is built on a foundation of thorough data analysis and clear communication between all team members. Her demanding nature stems from a belief in pushing boundaries, extracting every ounce of potential from the team and the machinery. What sets Bronte apart is her ability to see the bigger picture, anticipating potential challenges and proactively implementing solutions.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail during races.
physical.description: Bronte is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with detailed race notes.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific brand of Australian coffee in the garage during races.
